verify.title: Get your Verified badge
verify.defaultSubtitle: Verification is optional — earn a Verified badge to build trust and stand out. You can always do this later.
verify.subtitleVerifiedOnly: This owner accepts verified contacts only. Get your Verified badge to reach them.
verify.subtitleProfile: Earn your Verified badge with DigiLocker — build trust and stand out. It's optional and takes a minute.
verify.subtitleMyListings: Verify with DigiLocker to earn your badge — every one of your listings ranks higher and your first gets a free 7-day Featured boost.
verify.openingBody: You'll sign in and approve consent on DigiLocker's secure page. Your Aadhaar number and OTP are entered there — never on Draazy. Please don't close this window.
verify.why1: Build trust — owners and tenants know you're a genuine person.
verify.why2: Rank higher and get faster responses on your listings and enquiries.
verify.why3: Takes about a minute, one time — and it's completely optional.
verify.how1: We securely redirect you to DigiLocker (Government of India).
verify.how2: You enter your Aadhaar & OTP on DigiLocker — never on Draazy.
verify.how3: You approve a one-time consent and your badge is issued.
verify.privacyBody1: From DigiLocker we receive only your name, date of birth, gender, address, photo and the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar.
verify.privacyBody2: We never see or store your full Aadhaar number or your OTP — those stay with DigiLocker. You consent to share this data under the DPDP Act, and can withdraw anytime.
verify.footer: One Aadhaar = one Verified badge · Powered by DigiLocker
verify.bannerHeadlineLeads_one: You've got {{count}} enquiry — verified owners get 3× more genuine ones
verify.bannerHeadlineLeads_other: You've got {{count}} enquiries — verified owners get 3× more genuine ones
verify.bannerHeadline: Get Verified — rank all your listings higher
verify.bannerBody: Verified owners appear above unverified ones and win more buyer trust. Your first verified listing also gets a free 7-day Featured boost. Optional, ~1 minute via DigiLocker.
verify.overviewBody: Verify once with DigiLocker to build trust, rank higher in search, and stand out to owners. Takes a minute — never required to browse or contact.
verify.buyerNudgeBody: This owner is verified — add your Verified badge to stand out from other enquiries.
